revised_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: TripPet iOS achievement medal raster art candidate, local-only, later converted into a transparent 768x768 PNG
Asset name: achievement_medal_postcards_tier_009
Primary request: Create one premium collectible postcard achievement medal for tier 9, GOLD rank, final ultimate gold medal. Based on the Chinese title concept "还是打包整个宇宙吧，全是我的真心". The image itself must contain no text, no numbers, no labels.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #ff00ff chroma-key background for background removal; one uniform color only, no shadows or gradients.
Subject: exactly one centered circular medal. Inside is a unified funny anthropomorphic postcard/envelope mascot, definitely a rectangular ivory postcard/envelope body with rounded corners and envelope fold lines, tiny cartoon arms and legs, expressive face. Tier 9 gag: the postcard mascot is triumphantly trying to gift-wrap the whole tiny universe, hugging a small glowing planet-and-stars bundle tied with a bow, overwhelmed but sincere and absurdly grand.
Medal border: GOLD rank level 4 of 4, ultimate: most ornate gold circular frame, grand crown, large symmetrical gold wings, layered bottom filigree, sparkling rays, starburst gems, strongest gold shine and cosmic aura, clearly more advanced than tier 6-8 while keeping the central circle readable.
Style/medium: polished 3D-like mobile game collectible, glossy enamel and metal, cute humorous center mascot, crisp small-UI readability, same family as travel and foot medals.
Composition/framing: one centered medal only, full object visible, generous padding, central postcard mascot inside circular core, no cropping.
Lighting/mood: brilliant golden glow plus cosmic blue-purple highlights, ultimate sincere comedy.
Color palette: radiant metallic gold border, ivory mascot, dark blue-purple cosmic bundle, white star glints; avoid #ff00ff anywhere in subject.
Text: none.
Constraints: no foot, no toes, no shoe, no sock, no animal, no human, no letters, no numbers, no Chinese, no labels, no address lines, no stamp marks, no postmark rings, no watermark, no suitcase, no money pile, no cast shadow, no reflection, do not create multiple medals.
